summary: The player understood the core tap-to-drop mechanic and reached 7/20 floors on their first run, but experienced confusion during the unresponsive 'MISSED!' transition and failed at 0 floors on their second attempt. Tightening the fail-state transition, speeding up the opening, and adding early-game forgiveness would make the first-time experience smoother.

items.title: Unresponsive screen and missing HUD during miss transition
items.evidence: After missing a drop at t=13.7s (S6) and t=19.2s (S4, S7), 'MISSED!' appeared while the block fell, and at t=20.3s (S5, S8) the HUD disappeared with no moving block visible. Taps during this window had no visible effect and triggered unclear_screen signals (27-39% confidence).
items.suggestion: Transition directly into the 'Tower Toppled' fail overlay as soon as a miss is registered, rather than leaving the player on a HUD-less tower screen where taps do nothing.

items.title: Instant fail on a single miss, including at 0 floors
items.evidence: A single miss ended the first run at 7/20 floors (S9), and a miss on the very first block ended the second run at 0 floors (S10), immediately pushing the player to the end card at t=23.0s (S12).
items.suggestion: Add a 1-miss grace/shield on the first few floors (or widen the initial block tolerance) so a single early mistap does not immediately end the run at 0 floors.

items.title: Slow time to first successful drop
items.evidence: It took 4.4s from the first playable frame until the player's first tap visibly stacked a block (S1), with the tutorial prompt still active at t=2.0s.
items.suggestion: Have the first block already sliding in on frame 1 with a pulsing tap indicator, and dismiss the tutorial prompt on the first tap so the player scores their first floor within 1-2 seconds.

items.title: No sliding block visible immediately after restart
items.evidence: Right after restarting at t=17.4s (S3), the screen showed 0/20 floors and 45s on the timer, but no sliding block was visible yet, causing an unclear_screen signal (36% confidence).
items.suggestion: Spawn the first sliding block already visible at the edge of the play area immediately upon tapping 'TRY AGAIN' so the player sees the round is active.
